description: The highest-severity scoring actions in range (the top 12 by severity, rarest first within a weight), one row per action and weight, placed by how often each happened. Each row ends with its severity weight (· 45), which the colour repeats: one colour per weight, from blue for 10 to deep red for 50, listed in the key below the chart. Rarest is on the left, so the top-left corner is rare and high-severity: where to look first. A failed change scores 40 whatever it changed, so it gets its own row, marked (failed). Hover a point for how many identities did it and when.

text.expr: length(data('actions')) > 12 ? 'Top 12 of ' + length(data('actions')) + ' scoring actions, by severity, rarest first within a weight' : length(data('actions')) ? (length(data('actions')) == 1 ? '1 scoring action' : length(data('actions')) + ' scoring actions') + ', by severity, rarest first within a weight' : 'No scoring actions for this selection in this time range'

url.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE attributes.elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change IS NOT NULL OR attributes.event.outcome == "failure" OR attributes.event.action IN ("invalidate_apikeys","anonymous_access_denied") OR (resource.attributes.service.name == "serverless-kibana" AND ((attributes.event.type IN ("change","creation","deletion") AND (attributes.event.action IS NULL OR NOT (attributes.event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time","saved_object_close_point_in_time")))) OR attributes.event.action IN ("rule_run_soon","secret_create"))) | STATS n = COUNT(*), ts_min = MIN(@timestamp), ts_max = MAX(@timestamp) BY attributes.user.email, attributes.api_key.name, attributes.user.name, attributes.event.action, scc = attributes.elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change IS NOT NULL, attributes.event.outcome, resource.attributes.service.name, et = MV_CONCAT(attributes.event.type, ","), housekeeping = (attributes.event.action IS NOT NULL AND attributes.event.action == "invalidate_apikeys" AND attributes.user.name IS NOT NULL AND attributes.user.name IN ("elastic.maintenance","autoscaling","elasticsearch-controller","elastic/fleet-server","elastic/kibana") AND attributes.api_key.name IS NULL) | EVAL attributes.event.type = SPLIT(et, ","), attributes.elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change = CASE(scc, "present") | EVAL risk = CASE(housekeeping, 0, attributes.event.action == "invalidate_apikeys", 45, attributes.event.action == "anonymous_access_denied", 35, attributes.elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change IS NOT NULL, 50, attributes.event.outcome == "failure", 40, (resource.attributes.service.name == "serverless-kibana" AND ((attributes.event.type IN ("change","creation","deletion") AND (attributes.event.action IS NULL OR NOT (attributes.event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time","saved_object_close_point_in_time")))) OR attributes.event.action IN ("rule_run_soon","secret_create"))) AND attributes.event.action IN ("workflow_run","workflow_test","workflow_execution_cancel"), 10, (resource.attributes.service.name == "serverless-kibana" AND ((attributes.event.type IN ("change","creation","deletion") AND (attributes.event.action IS NULL OR NOT (attributes.event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time","saved_object_close_point_in_time")))) OR attributes.event.action IN ("rule_run_soon","secret_create"))) AND (attributes.event.type == "deletion" OR attributes.event.action == "rule_disable"), 30, (resource.attributes.service.name == "serverless-kibana" AND ((attributes.event.type IN ("change","creation","deletion") AND (attributes.event.action IS NULL OR NOT (attributes.event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time","saved_object_close_point_in_time")))) OR attributes.event.action IN ("rule_run_soon","secret_create"))), 25, 0) | WHERE risk > 0 | EVAL actor = COALESCE(attributes.user.email, attributes.api_key.name, attributes.user.name, "<anonymous>") | STATS events = SUM(n), identities = COUNT_DISTINCT(actor), first_ts = MIN(ts_min), last_ts = MAX(ts_max) BY action = attributes.event.action, risk | EVAL label = CASE(risk == 40 AND NOT (action LIKE "*fail*" OR action LIKE "*denied*"), CONCAT(action, " (failed)"), action) | EVAL label = CONCAT(label, " · ", TO_STRING(risk)) | SORT risk DESC, events ASC, action ASC | LIMIT 200

axis.title: Occurrences in range (log scale) · rarer to the left

values.expr: length(data('actions')) ? split(trim((indexof('|' + join(pluck(slice(data('actions'), 0, 12), 'risk'), '|') + '|', '|50|') >= 0 ? '50 ' : '') + (indexof('|' + join(pluck(slice(data('actions'), 0, 12), 'risk'), '|') + '|', '|45|') >= 0 ? '45 ' : '') + (indexof('|' + join(pluck(slice(data('actions'), 0, 12), 'risk'), '|') + '|', '|40|') >= 0 ? '40 ' : '') + (indexof('|' + join(pluck(slice(data('actions'), 0, 12), 'risk'), '|') + '|', '|35|') >= 0 ? '35 ' : '') + (indexof('|' + join(pluck(slice(data('actions'), 0, 12), 'risk'), '|') + '|', '|30|') >= 0 ? '30 ' : '') + (indexof('|' + join(pluck(slice(data('actions'), 0, 12), 'risk'), '|') + '|', '|25|') >= 0 ? '25 ' : '') + (indexof('|' + join(pluck(slice(data('actions'), 0, 12), 'risk'), '|') + '|', '|10|') >= 0 ? '10 ' : '')), ' ') : []
